model: Two simply supported 2.4 m RHS 80x60x3 crossbeams, each carrying half of uniform roof uplift; elastic small-deflection beam equations
excluded: Site basic wind speed, terrain/topography/risk factors and load combinations
Local roof edge suction, cladding spans, roof connections and purlin stability
Lateral loading, torsion, frame joint stiffness, fatigue, corrosion and seismic effects
Anchor tension/shear interaction, embedment, concrete breakout, soil bearing and overturning
decision: No construction release. Qualified local structural engineer must determine governing loads, connections and foundations. A low screening stress is not approval.
